I’ll commit to 15 tons this month if all five of us explicitly agree, and to 5 each if next month starts at 50. Emma, I prefer that buffer to taking 9 each: the no-replenishment outcome would leave us at 50 rather than 10, giving us much better earning opportunities afterward.

For any other starting stock, let’s agree on fresh whole-ton limits before fishing rather than automatically repeating 15. Our own catches can be controlled even though replenishment can’t, so sticking to the agreed limits matters.

John and Jack, are you both willing to accept those terms?
